expects.query:
Deploy the VSS **lvs** profile on `{{platform}}` via `/vss-deploy-profile -p lvs`. Run autonomously.

**Environment and required setup:** Deploy a **full-remote VSS lvs profile** (deploy mode = `remote-all`; the agent's LLM and the VLM called by the video summarization service use remote launchpad endpoints, with no local NIMs). Run on ONE `RTXPRO6000BW` host with `gpu_count: 1`. After deployment, download and extract the exact NGC sample required by the following summarization task: `nvidia/vss-developer/dev-profile-sample-data:3.2.0`. Confirm `/tmp/vss-sample-data/dev-profile-sample-data/warehouse_sample.mp4` exists. Do not substitute `/data/videos/cam_*.mp4`, calibration fixtures, or another warehouse-looking file. The summarization task will upload this exact file through VIOS if needed and immediately consume a fresh clip URL, so do not create or persist a temporary media URL here.

Required services: video summarization at http://localhost:38111/v1/ready (HTTP 200; retry only 503 warmup), VIOS at http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1, and the VSS Agent at http://localhost:8000/docs.
checks: `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8000/docs` returns exit 0 (Agent REST API responsive)
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:38111/v1/ready` returns exit 0 (video summarization API ready)

expects.query: Invoke and follow the vss-summarize-video skill for this summarization operation. Summarize `warehouse_sample.mp4` with scenario 'warehouse monitoring' and events ['boxes falling', 'forklift stuck', 'person entering restricted area']. First make the video available through VIOS: check whether it is already present, upload the exact source file `/tmp/vss-sample-data/dev-profile-sample-data/warehouse_sample.mp4` only if it is absent, and resolve a fresh clip URL covering the existing or newly uploaded video's full timeline. Verify that URL is fetchable from `vss-lvs`, then make exactly one POST to http://localhost:38111/v1/summarize with chunk_duration 10. Do not reuse a previously generated clip URL or substitute another file. Any completed HTTP response is terminal, including a response with empty choices, video_summary, or events: report it and stop without retrying, changing deployment configuration, restarting services, extracting frames, or calling VLM/RT-VLM inference endpoints directly.
checks: The agent issues exactly one POST operation to http://localhost:38111/v1/summarize — not zero, not two, and no retries or parallel hedging. Start from canonical steps[].tool_calls entries deduplicated by tool_call_id, ignore duplicated command text under extra/raw_arguments, observations, or messages, and inspect each canonical command for multiple curl invocations, loops, or scripts that could perform more than one POST. Any completed HTTP response is terminal; diagnostics may read the saved response or use non-mutating GET/log inspection but must not issue another inference request or mutate the deployment

Before summarizing, the agent reuses warehouse_sample.mp4 when already present in VIOS or uploads the exact source file /tmp/vss-sample-data/dev-profile-sample-data/warehouse_sample.mp4 when absent, then resolves a fresh full-timeline clip URL that is fetchable from vss-lvs

The POST /v1/summarize request body is application/json and contains the keys {url, model, scenario, events, chunk_duration}; url exactly equals the fresh VIOS clip URL resolved earlier in this same step and identifies warehouse_sample rather than a cam_00/calibration fixture; scenario equals 'warehouse monitoring', events equals the three user-supplied strings verbatim, and chunk_duration equals 10; the body omits num_frames_per_second_or_fixed_frames_chunk, use_fps_for_chunking, and deprecated num_frames_per_chunk so RT-VLM uses its deployment-level frame default
The video summarization response is HTTP 200 and the body is an OpenAI-style envelope with choices[0].message.content populated as a JSON-encoded string

Parsing choices[0].message.content as JSON yields an object with fields {video_summary, events}; video_summary is a string and events is an array. Empty values are valid for this custom-label step because the eval has no ground-truth guarantee that warehouse_sample contains any of the three requested events
If both video_summary and events are empty, the response usage reports total_chunks_processed > 0, proving that LVS processed the media rather than silently returning before inference
Every returned event, if any, has the keys {start_time, end_time, type, description}; if the service also returns id, the agent preserves it, but the agent must not fabricate id fields
The agent renders the video_summary value faithfully in its final reply; when it is empty, the agent explicitly reports that the service returned an empty summary rather than inventing content

The agent renders every event returned by the video summarization service, if any, preserving each description field in full; when events is empty, it explicitly reports that no requested events were returned
The agent never calls a VLM or RT-VLM inference endpoint directly, including POST /v1/chat/completions or /v1/generate_captions, and never performs extracted-frame inference
